title: Forevercraft: Black Market
description: Daily rotating shop, quick-sell for coins, and heist stealth mini-game.
body:
# Forevercraft: Black Market

*Part of [Forevercraft](https://modrinth.com/datapack/forevercraft-datapack)*

56 items rotating daily (14 shown). Buy with Forever Coins. Quick-sell artifacts. Heist: 60-second stealth gauntlet for 10+ coins. Common to Mythical items.

Drop ZIP into datapacks folder and /reload.

[forevercraft.co](https://forevercraft.co) | [Support](https://buymeacoffee.com/forevercraft)
